items.question: Do I need a website first, or can I start with an agent?
items.answer: Either path works. Start with an agent on an existing site, launch a new site then add the agent, or begin with content that feeds both.

items.question: Is this only for support chat?
items.answer: No. Divvylore covers sales and support — lead capture, resolution, website publishing, and content that keeps the agent informed.

items.question: Where do registration and login happen?
items.answer: All account actions happen in app.divvylore.com.

items.question: Can we keep a human in the loop?
items.answer: Yes. Escalate complex or high-stakes conversations to people with full context.
